{{Quote|Your last master isn't coming back. Got a problem with that?''"<br />"''Absolutely not. He called me unpleasant names and never bathed. Not that there is anything wrong with that, master...|The [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] and [[2V-R8 (Hunter)|2V-R8]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] '''smuggler''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> when a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]] attempted to steal the [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|smuggler's]] [[Hunter's D5-Mantis Patrol Craft|D5-''Mantis'' Patrol Craft]] docked in [[Docking Bay B-04]] in the [[Dromund Kaas spaceport]]. The smuggler ordered the [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]] in the docking bay to kill the bounty hunter, however the bounty hunter [[Death/Legends|killed]] everyone in the docking bay including the smuggler.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The smuggler first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
